act_title: The Industrial Reconstruction Bank (Transfer of Undertakings and Repeal) Act, 1997
title: Undertakings of the Reconstruction Bank to vest in company
text:
3. Undertakings of the Reconstruction Bank to vest in company.—On such date as the Central

Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, appoint, there shall be transferred to, and vest
in, the Company, the undertakings of Reconstruction Bank.
